# Turfy (Playturfy)

> Free football match live scoring, tournament bracket & league management, and player stats tracker app. 100% free forever, zero ads, works offline.

- Website: https://playturfy.com/
- Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.turfy.matchscorer
- Football News Feed: https://playturfy.com/news.html
- Platform: Android (Android 5.0+) — iOS / iPhone version in active development
- Pricing: 100% free forever (no subscriptions, no per-team fees, no in-app purchases, zero ads)

## Supported Football & Futsal Formats
- **Small-Sided & Turf Football**: 5-a-side, 6-a-side, 7-a-side, 8-a-side, 9-a-side, astro-turf cages, futsal, and street football.
- **Full-Pitch Football**: Standard 11v11 academy, school, college, Sunday league, and community club matches.
- **Custom Match Rules**: Configurable half lengths, extra time, penalty shootouts, squad sizes, and rolling substitutions.

## Core Features
- **Live Match Scoring**: Record goals, assists, yellow/red cards, substitutions, own goals, and penalty shootouts with a live pitch timer.
- **Tournament & League Management**: Automatic fixture generation, live standings tables (PTS, P, W, D, L, GD), and brackets for Round Robin leagues, Single-Elimination Knockouts, Group Stage + Knockout playoffs, and Finals.
- **Player & Team Statistics**: Automatic career and tournament leaderboards for Golden Boot (top scorers), top assists, clean sheets, disciplinary cards, and appearances.
- **100% Offline First**: Score matches and run tournaments on pitches with weak or zero mobile signal; data saves on-device and syncs to the cloud automatically when reconnected.
- **Live OBS Broadcasting Scoreboard**: Generate a live browser-source URL to overlay real-time scores, timers, and team names onto OBS Studio, Streamlabs, or vMix streams.
- **Instant PDF & WhatsApp Match Reports**: One-tap export of printable PDF match sheets, tournament tables, and visual social media match summary cards for WhatsApp and Instagram.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **What is the best free app to organize a football tournament or score matches live?** Turfy (Playturfy) lets organizers create Round Robin, Group Stage, and Knockout football tournaments with live scoring, automatic standings, and player stats completely free with no ads.
- **Is Turfy really 100% free?** Yes, every feature—unlimited tournaments, teams, players, PDF reports, and OBS overlays—is free forever with zero ads.
- **Does it work without internet?** Yes, match scoring and tournament brackets work completely offline and sync when back online.
- **Who is it for?** Grassroots football players, 5-a-side / 7-a-side turf organizers, academy coaches, school/college sports committees, and community leagues worldwide.
